summary: Explore the latest in banking technology and innovation trends with our exper-led training course. Stay ahead in the evolving financial landscape.
lede: Banking technology training helps banking professionals assess digital change and set priorities for improving services and operations. Participants evaluate mobile and open banking, payment modernization, RegTech, and AI-assisted workflows while considering delivery risks and controls. They develop innovation priorities, API control maps, risk checklists, and roadmaps to support decisions about technology adoption and channel improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who help banks evaluate innovation, modernize services, and govern digital change across channels, risk, operations, and product teams.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of banking operations, digital channels, or financial services transformation. Prior exposure to core banking, payments, compliance, or product management helps, but no programming is required for completion. If your role touches digital banking strategy, innovation governance, fraud controls, or customer experience, you will be able to apply the course content directly to your work.
